page1.heading: Who is he?
page1.subheading: Adnan Abdullah is a self-made industrialist. He likely inherited the land or initial business from his father, expanded it during the construction boom, and now supplies major contractors, municipalities, and giga-projects.

page2.heading: What He Wants
page2.subheading:
• Respect & Legacy: He is focused on ensuring his sons are prepared to take over the business.
• Stability: He requires clear regulatory roadmaps to ensure operational consistency as he navigates the decarbonization process.
• Reputation: As a vital national contributor, he seeks to balance his industrial output with responsible decarbonization.
• Control: He prioritizes proven technologies to safeguard his role as a stable contributor to the national infrastructure.
